gloss: suffrage, right to participate in government

definitions.gloss: suffrage, political rights, right to participate in government
definitions.explanation: The right of citizens to participate in political processes, including the right to vote and the right to run for office.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}の{参政権|さんせいけん}が{認|みと}められた。
{参政権|さんせいけん}は{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}の{基本|きほん}だ。
{日本|にほん}では{満|まん}18{歳|さい}から{参政権|さんせいけん}が{与|あた}えられる。
examples.english: In Japan, political rights are granted from the age of 18.

notes:
FORMS:
{参政|さんせい} (participation in government) + {権|けん} (right). {参政|さんせい} itself is {参|さん} (participate) + {政|せい} (politics).

USAGE:
Includes both {選挙権|せんきょけん} (right to vote) and {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん} (right to run for office). Often appears in discussions of history, civics, and constitutional law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参政権|さんせいけん}を{認|みと}める: to recognize suffrage
- {参政権|さんせいけん}を{与|あた}える: to grant suffrage
- {参政権|さんせいけん}を{獲得|かくとく}する: to obtain suffrage
- {女性|じょせい}{参政権|さんせいけん}: women's suffrage
